title: 等预算下MCTS与随机重启列表调度在DAG工作流中的对比研究
summary: 该研究在等预算条件下对比MCTS与随机重启列表调度在DAG工作流调度中的表现。结果显示，在2048次评估预算下，MCTS比随机重启差2.88%，且差距并非预算不足所致。随机重启在稀疏不规则工作流上优势明显，而MCTS的确定性选择规则导致试验相关性过高。
summary_en: This study compares MCTS and randomized-restart list scheduling for DAG workflows under equal budgets. At 2048 evaluated schedules, MCTS is 2.88% worse than restarts, not due to budget starvation. Restarts excel on sparse irregular workflows, while MCTS's deterministic selection rule causes correlated trials.
